tasks.goal: Find the REAL format and any CONCRETE examples of OAuth2 'applicationId' used by OMPFinex (Iranian crypto exchange). This is for an authorized bug bounty test.

Determine whether a headless-browser end-to-end PoC is feasible on this machine, and if YES, actually build (but only smoke-test locally) a Playwright/Selenium script that would prove an OAuth2 postMessage token-theft against my.ompfinex.com.

Verify the SERVER-SIDE contract of the OMPFinex OAuth2 authorize endpoint using a real (user-owned) session token: prove that POST /v1/oauth/authorize with a syntactically-valid-but-fake applicationId reaches application validation (NOT auth failure), and map what ID formats pass client-side format validation.
